notablePrerequisites: Othelm does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
When Dross Scorpion dies, it triggers, untapping Othelm.
Activate Othelm by paying {2} and tapping it, returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
